item.title: My dogs are my resume
item.description:
My dogs are my resume

Stress Training for Dogs

Escape and avoidance training to teach Griz to handle stress better and listen even when no rewards are available. This is 4 sessions of forced fetch training.

Trailing Games, Training Through Play

Search and rescue style double blind retrieves. Two red balls (hard for dogs to see, so she has to use her nose) are placed out of sight, then Griz is cast to each one in order.

item.title: Griz Urban Trailing, Hard Pack, and Dirt Pile Tracking
item.description:
Griz Urban Trailing, Hard Pack, and Dirt Pile Tracking

Urban Search and Rescue Trailing

This is a search and rescue urban training. The trail is about 40 minutes old. I was given a point last seen and a direction of travel, and I knew there was 1 unmarked corner to work through. Along the trail there is a distraction with another dog. The goal of this exercise was to help me learn when Griz is on odor, and when she’s following drifting odor.
